item.title: Child killed in truck accident in Sylhet
item.description: A seven-year-old child was killed after being run over by a truck in the Jaflong area of Gowainghat Upazila on Tuesday morning.The deceased was identified as Nayan Mia, son of Khairul Islam of Kashipara area in Osmaninagar Upazila. He had been living with his family in a rented house in Mohammadpur area of Jaflong.According to local residents and police, the accident occurred around 11:30 AM on the Mamaar Dokan–Mohammadpur road when Nayan was crossing the road. item.title: 2 AL activists held at Benapole while attempting to cross border
item.description: Two brothers identified as activists of Awami League (AL) were detained by immigration authorities at Benapole on Tuesday afternoon while allegedly trying to cross into India.The detainees are Sadiqur Rahman Shamim, 36, and Sajidur Rahman, 32, sons of Jalal Uddin from the Halurgan area of Sunamganj. item.title: 14 Bhola villages begin Ramadan a day early
item.description: At least 3,000 families in 14 villages of Bhola began observing the holy month of Ramadan a day earlier, aligning their fast with Saudi Arabia.According to locals, the residents started fasting on Wednesday after taking sehri early in the morning, local sources said.The villages are spread across five upazilas of the district, where people have long followed the Saudi moon sighting to determine the start of Ramadan and the dates of Eid. item.description: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman on Wednesday paid tribute to the martyrs of the Liberation War at the National Martyrs' Memorial in Savar on the first working day of his government.At 11:00am, the Prime Minister laid a wreath at the memorial. item.title: EC asked to prepare Dhaka, Chattogram city polls
item.description: The government has asked the Election Commission to begin preparations for elections in three major city corporations following the completion of parliamentary polls.The Local Government Division sent letters to the commission requesting necessary steps to organise elections for Dhaka North City Corporation, Dhaka South City Corporation and Chattogram City Corporation.Officials at the EC’s election management wing confirmed that they received the letters and are preparing to place the matter bef

item.title: Abdus Sattar appointed as PM's principal secy
item.description: Retired secretary ABM Abdus Sattar has been appointed as principal secretary to Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.It said Sattar will serve a one-year term from the date of joining and he must relinquish any existing professional, business or employment ties with any government, semi-government or private entity in order to take up the role.He was appointed private secretary to BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman last month.

item.title: Bodies of young man and woman found floating on Cox’s Bazar beach
item.description: The bodies of a young man and a young woman were recovered from the beach in Cox's Bazar on Wednesday morning, creating concern among locals.According to police, the unidentified bodies were found around 9:00 AM along the beach near the Marine Drive road, specifically in the North Lombori and Mitapani canal boat jetty areas under Teknaf Sadar Union.Local residents first noticed the bodies floating near the shore and informed authorities. item.title: PM Tarique Rahman to address nation this evening
item.description: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman is scheduled to address the nation at 7PM on Wednesday.Bangladesh Television (BTV) will telecast the speech live.This will be his first televised address since assuming office.All television channels have been requested to air the speech from BTV.
